motion_rule: he rides a loose log down a racing millrace, the camera racing backwards ahead so the ledger stacks tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; the current carries him through every beat and he never works a prop standing; head half the frame, from 6.5 a low angle, head low; new shot size each beat, one action per beat, camera move every beat; the picture fills the vertical frame top to bottom with no bars
character: a broad brown beaver with a chewed pencil behind his ear, deadpan
second_characters: ONE frantic duck clerk paddling the race beside him, slapping a fresh stamped sheet flat over every bank opening a breath before he reaches it
props: ONE fat paper folder gripped in his teeth, loose sheets streaming off it
prop_continuity: the folder only swells thicker beat by beat and never opens flat; the pencil stays behind his ear to the end
environment: a flooded paper-mill canal at noon, ledger stacks to the roof both banks, a long row of round burrow mouths cut into the near bank, the millrace racing under
light_events: hard noon sun through the stack gaps bars his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: KAZH-dyj, o-be-SHCHA-yu, se-BE, ra-zo-BRAT-sya, i-SHCHU, svo-YU, no-RU
audio.pacing: 0.4-3.6 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.5-7.1 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 7.1 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the race roaring, paper walls rustling, a wet thump each time the duck slaps a sheet, a mill wheel grinding from 7.1

timeline.a: he rides the log at the lens, sheets streaming off the folder in his teeth, stacks tearing past
he spits the folder into his paw without slowing
he waves the folder at the lens as the race hauls him along
the duck swings in at his ear and is carried on past him
a row of open round burrow mouths runs past him along the near bank
he lunges off the log at the first open mouth, the folder still in his paw
the duck slaps a stamped sheet flat over that mouth ahead of his paw
he tears past a second mouth and it goes flat under a sheet too
he rears up on the log, hunting an opening still dark
he claws at a papered mouth and comes up with a fistful of wet sheets
the papering runs ahead of him down the bank, mouth after mouth going flat
he swings the folder at the bank and the sheets only stack thicker
the near bank is one flat paper wall the whole lane long, not an opening left
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the fat folder at his ear, paper rolling past behind

must_appear: one fat paper folder in his paw; at 2.6 a row of open round burrow mouths runs along the near bank; from 4.5 the duck slaps a stamped sheet flat over each mouth before he reaches it; at 8.5 the bank is one flat paper wall with no opening; at 9.3 his deadpan face is in the lens, the folder at his ear
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal bars, a 16:9 frame, night, dark scene, standing bystanders, a still background, a parked camera, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, the beaver getting inside anything, the duck holding still, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
